G4800.def:
συν-ζάω (Rec. συζ-),
to live with: opposite to συναποθανεῖν, 2Co 7:3; of life in union with Christ, here and hereafter, Rm 6:8, 2Tm 2:11.†
(AS)

G4801.def:
συν-ζεύγνυμι
(Rec. συζ-), [in LXX: Eze.1:11, 23 (חָבַר) * ;]
to yoke to­gether: metaphorically, of union in wedlock, Mt 19:6, Mc 10:9.†
(AS)

G4802.def:
συν-ζητέω
(Rec. συζ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: Ne 2:4 AB1 (בָּקַשׁ pi.) * ;]
__1. to search or examine together (Plat.).
__2. In NT (and π., see MM, xxiii; also in MGr., see Kennedy, Sources, 155), to discuss, dispute: Mc 1:27 12:28, Lc 24:15; before quæst. indir., Mc 9:10; with dative of person(s), Mc 8:11 At 6:9; before πρός, with accusative of person(s), Mc 9:14, 16, At 9:29; id. before quæst. indir., Lc 22:23.†
(AS)

G4803.def:
συν-ζήτηαις (Rec. συζ-), -εως, ἡ
disputation: At 28:29 (WH, R, txt., om.).†
(AS)

G4805.def:
σύν-ζυγος (Rec. ουζ-), or as WH, mg., Σύνζυγος, -ον
(συνζεύγνυμι), [in Aq., Eze.23:21 * ;]
a yoke fellow. Prob., as proper name, Σ. γνήσιε, genuinely Synzygus, S. properly so-called, Fp 4:3 (see ICC, Lft., in l; MM, xxiii).†
(AS)

G4806.def:
συν-ζωο-ποιέω (Rec. συζ-), ῶ-,
to make alive or quicken together with; metaphorically, of the spiritual life: τ. Χριστῷ, Ef 2:5; σὺν τ. Χ., Cl 2:13.†
(AS)

G4807.def:
συκάμινος, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX for שִׁקְמָה (pl.) ;]
the mulberry tree
(Lat. morus; cf. μόρον, 1Ma.6:34 *),
the sycamine: Lc 17:6. (In LXX, σ. appears to represent the συκόμορος (see: συκομορέα), but St. Luke distinguishes between the two; see ICC, in l; DB, iv, 634.) †
(AS)

G4808.def:
συκῆ (contr. fr. συκέα), -ῆς, ἡ
(σῦκον), [in LXX for תְּאֵן ;]
a fig-tree: Mt 21:19-21 24:32, Mc 11:13, 20-21 13:28, Lc 13:6-7 21:29, Jo 1:49, 51, Tg 3:12, Ap 6:13.†
(AS)

G4809.def:
συκο-μορέα (Rec. -μωραία, L, -μωρέα), -ας, ἡ, more commonly (so Aq., Sm., Sl 78:47, Is 9:10) συκόμορος
(σῦκον + μόρον, the black mulberry),
a fig-mulberry, a sycamore: Lc 19:4 (cf. συκάμινος).†
(AS)

G4810.def:
σῦκον, -ου, τό
[in LXX for תְּאֵן ]
a fig: Mt 7:16, Mc 11:13, Lc 6:44 Tg 3:12.†
(AS)

G4811.def:
συκοφαντέω, -ῶ
(σῦκον, φαίνω), [in LXX: Gn 43:18 (גָּלַל hithpo.), Lv 19:11 (שָׁקַר pi.), Jó 35:9, Sl 119:122, Pv 14:31 2:16 28:3, Ec 4:1 (עָשַׁק) ;]
to act the συκοφάντης (on conjectures as to the origin of the term, see LS, see word), to accuse falsely (Aristoph., Xen., al.): Lc 3:14 (R, mg.) Lc 19:8 (RV, exact wrongfully; but cf. Hatch, Essays, 89 ff., see also Field, Notes, 56 f.; MM, xxiv).†
(AS)

G4812.def:
συλαγωγέω, -ῶ
(σύλη, booty + ἄγω),
to carry off as spoil, lead captive (θυγατέρα, Heliod., Aeth., 10, 35): metaphorically, Cl 2:8.†
(AS)

G4813.def:
συλάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Ep. Jr 1:18 * ;]
with accusative of person(s), to strip, plunder, spoil: 2Co 11:8.†
(AS)

G4815.def:
συλ-λαμβάνω
[in LXX for תָּפַשׂ, הָרָה, etc. ;]
__1. with accusative, to bring together, collect.
__2. to seize, take: with accusative of person(s), as a prisoner, Mt 26:55, Mc 14:48, Lc 22:54, Jo 18:12, At 1:16 12:3; pass., At 23:27; mid., in sense of act., At 26:21; σ. ἄγραν ἰχθύων, Lc 5:9.
__3. C. dative of person(s), to take part with, assist, succour; mid., in same sense: Lc 5:7, Fp 4:3.
__4. Of a woman, to conceive: absol., Lc 1:24; before ἐν γαστρί, Lc 1:31; with accusative, Lc 1:36; ib. before ἐν τ. κοιλίᾳ, Lc 2:21; metaphorically, of lust producing sin, Tg 1:15.†
(AS)

G4816.def:
συλ-λέγω
[in LXX chiefly for לָקַט ;]
to bring together, collect, gather up: with accusative of thing(s), Mt 13:28-30; pass., Mt 13:40; with accusative, before ἀπό, Mt 7:16; id. before ἐκ, Mt 13:41, Lc 6:44; before εἰς, Mt 13:48.†
(AS)

G4817.def:
συλ-λογίζομαι
[in LXX chiefly for חָשַׁב pi. ;]
__1. to compute.
__2. to reason: Lc 20:5.†
(AS)

G4818.def:
συν-λυπέω
(Rec. συλλ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: Sl 69:20, Is 51:19 (נוּד) * ;]
to make to grieve with (Arist.). Pass., to be moved to grief by sympathy: before ἐπί, with dative, Mc 3:5.†
(AS)

G4819.def:
συμ-βαίνω
[in LXX for עָשָׂה, קָרָא, קָרָה, etc. ;]
__1. to stand with the feet together.
__2. to come together, come to terms.
__3. Of events, to come to pass, happen: with dative of person(s), Mc 10:32, At 3:10 20:19, 1Co 10:11, 1Pe 4:12, 2Pe 2:22; absol., τὰ σνμβεβηκότα, Lc 24:14 (cf. 1Ma.4:26); with accusative and nf., At 21:35.†
(AS)

G4820.def:
συν-βάλλω
(Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: 2Cr 25:19 (גָּרָה hith.), Is 46:6 (זוּל), Jr 43:3 (סוּת hi.), Wis.5:8, al. ;]
to throw together, hence,
__(a) of speech (before λόγους, Eur., al.), to discuss, confer (sc. λόγους): with dative of person(s), Lc 11:53, WH, mg., At 17:18; before πρὸς ἀλλήλους, At 4:15;
__(b) to reflect, consider, ponder: ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ, Lc 2:19;
__(with) to meet with, fall in with: At 20:14; in hostile sense, εἰς πόλεμον, with dative (εἰς μάχην, Polyb.), Lc 14:31;
__(d) mid., to contribute (Polyb., al.; cf. MM, xxiv): At 18:27.†
(AS)

G4821.def:
συμ-βουλεύω
[in LXX chiefly for יָעַץ ;]
__1. to advise, counsel: with dative of person(s), Jo 18:14; id. before inf., Ap 3:18.
__2. Mid., to take counsel, consult: before ἵνα, Mt 26:4 ("reciprocal middle," see M, Pr., 157); with inf., At 9:23.†
(AS)

G4822.def:
συν-βιβάζω
(Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: Êx 4:12, 15, Lv 10:11, Jz 13:8, Sl 32:8 (יָרָה hi.); Êx 18:16, Dt 4:9, Is 40:13 (יָדַע hi.), Is 40:14 (בִּין hi.), Da TH Dn 9:22 (שָׂכַל hi.) * ;]
__1. to join or knit together, unite: Ef 4:16, Cl 2:2 (but see infr.), Cl 2:19.
__2. to compare, consider, conclude (Plat.): At 16:10.
__3. to deduce, prove, demonstrate (Arist.): At 9:22.
__4. As in LXX ("translation Greek," = ἐμβιβάζω, metaphorically), to teach, instruct: 1Co 2:16 At 19:33, R, mg. (also in Vg., Cl 2:2, instructi, but see supr.).†
(AS)

G4823.def:
1. to advise, counsel , Lat. consulere alicui, with dative pers. et infinitive, to advise one to do a thing, (Herdotus Historicus), etc.
2. without the infinitive, ς. τινί τι (Herdotus Historicus); ς. τι to recommend a measure, (Herdotus Historicus), attic:—;Pass., τὰ συμβουλευόμενα the advice given , (Xenophon Historicus)
3. absolute to advise, give advice , (Sophocles Tragicus); ὁ συμβουλεύων or -εύσας, an adviser , Lat. auctor sententiae, (Aristotle Philosopher)
4. Mid. to consult with a person, i. e. ask his advice , Lat. consulere aliquem, with dative, (Herdotus Historicus), etc.: absolute to consult, deliberate , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G4824.def:
συμβούλιον, -ου, τό
(σύμβουλος), [in LXX: 4Ma.17:17 א * ;]
a word of the Græco-Roman period (of. Lat. consilium, and see Deiss., BS, 238) = cl. συμβουλία (Arist., Xen.),
__1. counsel: σ. λαμβάνειν, Mt 12:14 22:15 27:7 28:12; διδόναι, Mc 3:6 (ποιεῖν, Rec.); ποιεῖν, Mc 15:1 (ἑτοιμάζειν, WH, mg.).
__2. By meton., a council (4Mac, l.with א; συνέδριον, AR): At 25:12 (see MM, xxiv).†
(AS)

G4825.def:
σύμβουλος, -ου, ὁ
(σύν, βουλή), [in LXX for יָעַץ and cogn. forms ;]
a counsellor, adviser: Rm 11:34 (LXX).†
(AS)

G4826G.def:
Συμεών, ὁ indecl., (Heb. שִׁמְעוֹן),
Simeon (so always AV; RV in Lc 2:25, 34 only), Symeon, a Heb. name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used;
__1. the son of Jacob (Gn 29:33): Ap 7:7.
__2. An ancestor of our Lord: Lc 3:30
__3. An aged worshipper in the Temple: Lc 2:25, 34.
__4. One surnamed Niger: At 13:1.
__5. The apostle Peter: At 15:14, 2Pe 1:1 (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).†
(AS)

G4826H.def:
Συμεών, ὁ indecl., (Heb. שִׁמְעוֹן),
Simeon (so always AV; RV in Lc 2:25, 34 only), Symeon, a Heb. name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used;
__1. the son of Jacob (Gn 29:33): Ap 7:7.
__2. An ancestor of our Lord: Lc 3:30
__3. An aged worshipper in the Temple: Lc 2:25, 34.
__4. One surnamed Niger: At 13:1.
__5. The apostle Peter: At 15:14, 2Pe 1:1 (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).†
(AS)

G4826I.def:
Συμεών, ὁ indecl., (Heb. שִׁמְעוֹן),
Simeon (so always AV; RV in Lc 2:25, 34 only), Symeon, a Heb. name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used;
__1. the son of Jacob (Gn 29:33): Ap 7:7.
__2. An ancestor of our Lord: Lc 3:30
__3. An aged worshipper in the Temple: Lc 2:25, 34.
__4. One surnamed Niger: At 13:1.
__5. The apostle Peter: At 15:14, 2Pe 1:1 (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).†
(AS)

G4826J.def:
Συμεών, ὁ indecl., (Heb. שִׁמְעוֹן),
Simeon (so always AV; RV in Lc 2:25, 34 only), Symeon, a Heb. name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used;
__1. the son of Jacob (Gn 29:33): Ap 7:7.
__2. An ancestor of our Lord: Lc 3:30
__3. An aged worshipper in the Temple: Lc 2:25, 34.
__4. One surnamed Niger: At 13:1.
__5. The apostle Peter: At 15:14, 2Pe 1:1 (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).†
(AS)

G4826K.def:
Συμεών, ὁ indecl., (Heb. שִׁמְעוֹן),
Simeon (so always AV; RV in Lc 2:25, 34 only), Symeon, a Heb. name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used;
__1. the son of Jacob (Gn 29:33): Ap 7:7.
__2. An ancestor of our Lord: Lc 3:30
__3. An aged worshipper in the Temple: Lc 2:25, 34.
__4. One surnamed Niger: At 13:1.
__5. The apostle Peter: At 15:14, 2Pe 1:1 (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).†
(AS)

G4827.def:
συν-μαθητής (Rec. συμμ-), -οῦ, ὁ
a fellow-disciple: Jo 11:16 (on the use of συν- in such compounds as this, see Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.).†
(AS)

G4828.def:
συν-μαρτυρέω (Rec. συμμ-), -ῶ,
to bear witness with: Rm 2:15; with dative, Rm 8:16; before ὅτι, Rm 9:1.†
(AS)

G4829.def:
συν-μερίζω
(Rec. συμμ-), [in LXX: Pv 29:24 א2 (חָלַק) * ;]
to distri­bute in shares. Mid., to have a share in: 1Co 9:13 (Diod., al.).†
(AS)

G4830.def:
συν-μέτοχος (Rec. συμμ-), -ον,
partaking together with; as subst., ὁ σ., a joint partaker (with dative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), FlJ, BJ, i, 24, 6): with genitive of thing(s), Ef 3:6; with genitive of person(s), Ef 5:7 (Arist.).†
(AS)

G4831.def:
συν-μιμητής (Rec. συμμ-), -οῦ, ὁ
a fellow-imitator: with genitive obj., Fp 3:17 (see ICC, in l). Not elsewhere.†
(AS)

G4832.def:
σύμ-μορφος, -ον
(σύν, μορφή),
__1. absol., similar (Luc.).
__2. con­formed to: with dative, Fp 3:21; with genitive, Rm 8:29 (see B1., § 36, 11; 37, 6).†
(AS)

G4833.def: Pass. to be conformed to , τινι (New Testament) (ML)

G4834.def:
συν-παθέω
(Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: 4Ma.5:25 AR 4Ma.13:23 * ;]
to have a fellow feeling for or with, sympathize with or in: with dative of thing(s), Hb 4:15; dative of person(s), Hb 10:34 (Arist., Plut., al.).†
(AS)

G4835.def:
συμπαθής, -ές
(σύν, πάσχω) [in LXX: Jó 29:25 A (אָבֵל), 4Ma.5:25 א, 4Ma.13:23 4Mac 15:4 * ;]
__1. affected by like feelings, sympathetic: 1Pe 3:8.
__2. exciting sympathy (Jb, l.with; Dion. H.).†
(AS)

G4836.def:
συν-παρα-γίνομαι
(Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX: Sl 83:8 (לָוָה ni.) * ;]
__1. to come up or be present together: before ἐπί, Lc 23:48.
__2. to come up to assist (Thuc., al.; 2Tm 4:16, Rec.).†
(AS)

G4837.def:
συν-παρα-καλέω (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ,
to call upon or exhort together (Plat.). Pass., to be strengthened or comforted with and among: Rm 1:12.†
(AS)

G4838.def:
συν-παρα-λαμβάνω
(Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX: Gn 19:17 (סָפָה ni.), Jó 1:4 (שָׁלַח ni), 3Ma.1:1 * ;]
to take along with: as a companion, with accusative, At 12:25 15:37-38 (on the tenses, see M, Pr., 130), Gl 2:1.†
(AS)

G4840.def:
συν-πάρειμι
(Rec. σνμπ-), [in LXX: Tob.12:12 ΑΒ, Pv 8:27 (?), Wis.9:10 * ;]
to be present together or with: with dative of person(s), At 25:24.†
(AS)

G4841.def:
συν-πάσχω
(Rec. συμπ-), [in Al.: 1Rs 22:8 * ;]
__1. to suffer together or with: Rm 8:17, 1Co 12:28.
__2. to sympathize with (Plat., Arist.).†
(AS)

G4842.def:
συν-πέμπω (Rec. συμπ-)
to send together with: with accusative and dative, 2Co 8:22; id. before μετά, with genitive, 2Co 8:18.†
(AS)

G4843.def:
συν-περι-λαμβάνω (Rec. συμπ-),
__1. to enclose (Eze.5:3 (צוּר) *).
__2. to embrace: with accusative of person(s), At 20:10.†
(AS)

G4844.def:
συμπόσιον, -ου, τό
(συμπίνω), [in LXX: Et 7:7 (מִשְׁתֶּה יַיִן) Et 4:17, 1Ma.16:16, 2Ma.2:27, 3Ma.4:16 3Mac 5:36 3Mac 6:33; σ. οἴνου, Sir 34:31 (31:31) Sir.35:5 (32:5), Sir.49:1 * ;]
__1. a drinking party
__2. By meton., of the party itself, the guests (Plut); pl., σ. σ. (colloq.; see M, Pr., 97), in parties or companies: Mc 6:39.†
(AS)

G4845.def:
συν-πληρόω
(Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: Jr 25:12 (נָפַל) * ;]
__1. to fill up completely (Thuc., of manning ships): of a ship filling with water, and by meton., of those on board, Lc 8:23.
__2. to complete, fulfil: of time (Je, l.with, and see MM, xxiv), Lc 9:51, At 2:1 (on the "durative inf.," see M, Pr., 233).†
(AS)

G4846.def:
συν-πνίγω (Rec. συμπ-),
to choke: of thronging by a crowd, Lc 8:42. Fig., of seed, τ. λόγον, Mt 13:22, Mc 4:7, 19, Lc 8:14.†
(AS)

G4847.def:
συν-πολίτης (Rec. σνμπ-), -ου, ὁ
a fellow-citizen: pl., σ. τ. ἁγίων, opposite to ξένοι κ. πάροικοι, Ef 2:19 (Eur.; C.I., 6446; condemned by Atticists; see Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.).†
(AS)

G4848.def:
συν-πορεύομαι
(Rec. σνμπ-), [in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ ;]
__1. to journey together (Plat., al.): with dative of person(s), Lc 7:11 14:25 24:15.
__2. to come together: Mc 10:1 (Plut., al.).†
(AS)

G4849.def:
1. a drinking-party, symposium , (Theognis Elegiacus), etc.
2. the room in which such parties were given, drinking-room , (Lucian) (ML)

G4851.def:
συμ-φέρω
[in LXX: Jr 33:14 (טוֹב), Pv 19:10 (נָאוֶה), Sir.30:19, al. ;]
__1. trans. to bring together: with accusative of thing(s), At 19:19.
__2. Intrans., and mostly impers., συμφέρει, it is expedient, profitable or an advantage: 1Co 6:12 10:23, 2Co 8:10; with inf. (M, Pr., 210), Mt 19:10, Jo 18:14; with dative, before ἵνα (Bl., § 69, 5), Mt 5:29-30 18:6, Jo 11:50 16:7. Ptcp., ςυμφέρων, profitable: 1Co 12:7; pl., At 20:20; (οὐ σ. sc. ἐστιν; = οὐ συμφέρει; cf. Thuc., iii, 44, 2), 2Co 12:1; as subst., τὸ σ., profit, Hb 12:10.†
(AS)

G4852.def:
σύν φημι (Rec. συμ-),
to consent, confess: with dative, before ὅτι, Rm 7:16.†
(AS)

G4853.def:
συμ-φυλέτης, -ου, ὁ
(σύν, φυλή; cf. σύμφυλος, Aq.: Zc 13:7; and see Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.)
a fellow-tribesman, fellow-countryman: 1Ts 2:14 (see M, Th., in l, and Intr. liii). Not found elsewhere.†
(AS)

G4854.def:
σύμ-φυτος, -ον
(συμφύω, to make to grow together) [in LXX: Zc 11:2 (בָּצַר), Et 7:7 Et 7:8 א2, Am 9:13, 3Ma.3:22 * ;]
__1. congenital, innate (Plat., al.; 3Mac, l.with).
__2. grown along with, united with: τ. ὁμοιώματι τ. θανάτου αὐτσῦ (see Field, Notes, 155 f.), Rm 6:5.†
(AS)

G4855.def:
συν-φύω
(Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: Wis.13:13 * ;]
to cause to grow together. Pass., to grow together or with (Plat. al.): Lc 8:7.†
(AS)

G4856.def:
συμ-φωνέω, -ῶ,
[in LXX: Gn 14:3 (H2266) 2Rs 12:8 (9) (H225 ni.), Is 7:2 (H5117), 4Ma.14:6 * ;]
prop., to agree in sound, be in harmony (Plat., Arist.). Metaphorical,
__(a) to agree with, agree together: Lc 5:36; with dative of thing(s), At 15:15; before περί, Mt 18:19; pass., with dative of person(s), συνεφωνήθη ὑμῖν, At 5:9;
__(b) to agree as to a price (Polyb., Diod.): with dative of person(s), genitive pret., Mt 20:13; before μετά . . . ἐκ, Mt 20:2.†
(AS)

G4857.def:
συμ-φώνησις, -εως, ἡ
(συμφωνέω),
concord, agreement: before πρός, with accusative of person(s), 2Co 6:15.†
(AS)

G4858.def:
συμφωνία, -ας, ἡ
(σύμφωνος), [in LXX: Dan LXX TH Dn 3:5, 15, TH Dn 3:7, 10 (סוּמְפּוֹנְיָה) 4Ma.14:3 A * ;]
__1. symphony, music: Lc 15:25
__2. a musical instrument (Polyb., al.; Da, ll. with; v MM, xxiv).†
(AS)

G4859.def:
σύμφωνος, -ον
(ούν, φωνή), [in LXX: Ec 7:14 (עֻמָּה), 4Ma.7:7 4Mac 14:7 * ;]
agreeing in sound. Metaphorical, harmonious, agreeing: ἐκ συμφώνου (for exx. from π., see Deiss., BS, 255), by agreement, 1Co 7:5.†
(AS)

G4860.def:
συμ-ψηφίζω
[in LXX: Jr 29:20 (Jr 49:20) A * ;]
to reckon together, count up: At 19:19.†
(AS)

G4862.def:
σύν (old Att. ξύν),
prep. with dative,
expressing association, fellowship and inclusion. It gradually gave way to μετά, with genitive (cf. LS, see word; Bl., §41, 3), and is therefore comparatively infrequent in NT, being rare in Mat.4, Mrk.6, Jhn.3, and elsewhere (exx. Tg 1:11, 2Pe 1:18) only in Lk (Gosp. and Ac) and Paul. With, together with: of companionship and association, Lc 2:13, Jo 21:3, At 10:23, al.; εἶναι σύν τινι, Lc 7:12, At 4:13, Fp 1:23, al.; of partisanship, At 4:13; οἱ σύν τινι, of attendants, companions or colleagues, Mc 2:26, Lc 5:9, At 5:17, al.; of assistance, ἡ χάρις τ. θεοῦ σὺν ἐμοί, 1Co 15:10; of two or more things together, almost = καί, Lc 23:11, At 3:4 10:2 14:5 23:25, Ef 3:18; σὺν Χριστῷ ζῆν, 2Co 13:4; besides (FlJ, LXX), σὺν πᾶσι τούτοις, Lc 24:21. In composition: with (συνχαίρω), together (συνωδίνω), altogether (συντελέω)
(AS)

G4863.def:
συν-άγω
[in LXX chiefly for אָסַף, also for קָבַץ, etc. (cf. Kennedy, Sources, 128) ;]
to gather or bring together: of things, Jo 6:12-13; before εἰς, Mt 3:12, al.; ἐκεῖ, Lc 12:18; ποῦ, Lc 12:17; συναγαγὼν πάντα (sc. εἰς ἀργύριον; see Field, Notes, 68, MM, xxiv), having sold off all: Lc 15:13; of persons, Jo 11:52; esp. of assemblies, Mt 2:4, Jo 11:47, At 14:27, al. Pass., to be gathered or come together: Mt 22:41, Mc 2:2, Lc 22:66, al.; before ἐπί Mc 5:21, At 4:27; πρός, Mt 13:2, Mc 4:1, al.; εἰς, Ap 19:17; ἐν, At 11:26; μετά, Mt 28:12; οὗ, Mt 18:20; ὅπου, Mt 26:57; ἐκεῖ, Jo 18:2, al.
In late writers (see Kennedy, Sources, 128; cf. Dt 22:2, al.), to receive hospitably, entertain: Mt 25:35, 38 25:43 (cf. ἐπι-συνάγω)
(AS)

G4864.def:
συν-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for עֵדָה, also for קָהָל, etc. ;]
prop., a bringing together;
__1. of things,
__(a) a gathering in of harvest;
__(b) a collection of money.
__2. Of persons,
__(a) a collecting, assembling (Polyb.);
__(b) an assembly (MM, xxiv; Deiss., LAE, 101 ff.): Ap 2:9 3:9; esp. of a Jewish religious assembly, a synagogue: Lc 12:11, At 9:2, al.; of a Christian assembly, Tg 2:2. By meton., of the building in which the assembly is held, a synagogue: Mt 10:17, Mc 1:21, al. (cf. Cremer, see word ἐκκλησία)
SYN.: ἐκκλησία (which see) (AS)

G4865.def:
συν-αγωνίζομαι
to strive together with, to help (prop., of sharing in a contest): with dative of person(s) and of thing(s), Rm 15:30.†
(AS)

G4866.def:
συν-αθλέω, -ῶ
= συναγωνίζομαι: with dative commod., Fp 1:27; with dative of person(s), before ἐν, Fp 4:3.†
(AS)

G4867.def:
συν-αθροίζω
[in LXX chiefly for קָבַץ ;]
to gather together, assemble: with accusative of person(s), At 19:25; pass., At 12:12.†
ἀθροίζω
(ἀθρόος, assembled in crowds, MM, VGT, see word; θρόος, a noise, tumult), [in LXX chiefly for קָבַץ ;]
to Gather, assemble: Lc 24:33.†
(AS)

G4868.def:
συν-αίρω
[in LXX: Êx 23:5 (עָזַב) * ;]
to take up together: σ. λόγον (of which there are several exx. in π.; see Deiss., LAE, 118 f.; MM, i, xxiv; M, Pr., 160), to settle accounts, Mt 18:23-24; before μετά, C. genitive of person(s), Mt 25:19.†
(AS)

G4869.def:
συν-αιχμάλωτος, -ου, ὁ
a fellow prisoner (prop., of a captive in war, see Lft., Col., 234): Rm 16:7, Cl 4:10, Phm 23.†
(AS)

G4870.def:
συν-ακολουθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 2Ma.2:4 2Mac 2:6 * ;]
to follow along with, accompany: with dative of person(s), Mc 14:51, Lc 23:49; before μετά, with genitive of person(s), Mc 5:37.†
(AS)

G4871.def:
συν-αλίζω
[in Al.: Sl 141:4 * ;]
to assemble with: At 1:4 (EV, mg., eating with, but on this rendering and on the force of the Pres. ptcp. here, see Field, Notes, 110).†
(AS)

G4872.def:
συν-ανα-βαίνω
[in LXX for עָלָה ;]
to go up with: with dative of person(s), before εἰς, with accusative loc., Mc 15:41, At 13:31.†
(AS)

G4873.def:
συν-ανά-κειμαι
[in LXX: 3Ma.5:39 * ;]
to recline with or together at table: Mt 14:9, Mc 6:22, Lc 7:49 14:15; with dative of person(s), Mt 9:10, Mc 2:15, Lc 14:10.†
(AS)

G4874.def:
συν-ανα-μίγνυμι
(accusative to Bl., 8, -μείγνυμι), [in LXX: Os 7:8 A ( hithpo.), Eze.20:18 A * ;]
to mix up together; pass., reflex, and metaphorically, to associate with (Plut., Ath., al.): 1Co 5:9 5:11, 2Ts 3:14 (see M, Th., 117).†
(AS)

G4875.def:
συν-ανα-παύομαι
[in LXX: Is 11:6 (רָבַץ) * ;]
with dative of person(s), to lie down to rest with, sleep with. Metaphorical, to be refreshed in spirit with: Rm 15:32 (L, om.).†
(AS)

G4876.def:
συν-αντάω, -ῶ
[in LXX for פָּגַע, פָּגַשׁ, קָרָא, קָרָה, etc. ;]
to meet with: with dative of person(s), Lc 9:18, 37 22:10, At 10:25, Hb 7:1, 10. Metaphorical, of events, to happen, befall (Ding. L., Plut., al.): At 20:22.†
(AS)

G4878.def:
συν-αντι-λαμβάνομαι
[in LXX: Gn 30:8 R (†), Êx 18:22, Nm 11:17 (נָשָׂא), Sl 89:21 (כּוּן ni.) * ;]
to take hold with at the side for assistance; hence, to take a share in, help in bearing, and generally, help (with various constructions, see LXX, ll. with, Deiss., LAE, 83 f.): with dative, Lc 10:40, Rm 8:26.†
(AS)

G4879.def:
συν-απ-άγω
[in LXX: Êx 14:6 (לָקַח) * ;]
to lead away with or together (Ex, l.with). Pass., metaphorically (as συμπεριφέρομαι, see LS, see word), to be carried away with: with dative, Gl 2:13, 2Pe 3:17; of accommodating one­self to (EV, condescend to) things or persons (on the meaning, see ICC, in I.; Field, Notes, 163), Rm 12:16.†
(AS)

G4880.def:
συν-απο-θνήσκω
[in LXX: Sir.19:10 * ;]
to die with or together: Mc 14:31, 2Co 7:3 (see Meyer, in l), 2Tm 2:11.†
(AS)

G4881.def:
συν-απ-όλλυμι
[in LXX chiefly for סָפָה ;]
to destroy with or together. Pass., to perish together (with): with dative of person(s), Hb 11:31.†
(AS)

G4882.def:
συν-απο-στέλλω
[in LXX: Êx 33:2, 12 (שָׁלַח), I Et 5:2 * ;]
to send along with: with accusative, 2Co 12:18 (cf. MM, xxiv).†
(AS)

G4883.def:
συν-αρμολογέω, -ῶ
(ἁρμός, λέγω), = cl. συναρμόζω,
to fit or frame together: of the parts of a building, Ef 2:21; of the members of the body, Ef 4:16 (Eccl.).†
(AS)

G4884.def:
συν-αρπάζω
[in LXX: Pv 6:25 (לָקַח), 2Ma.3:27 2Mac 4:41, 4Ma.5:4 * ;]
"perfective " of ἁοπάζω (see M, Pr., 113),
__(a) to seize and carry away (so most commonly) : At 27:15;
__(b) to seize and hold: Lc 8:29, At 6:12 19:29.†
(AS)

G4885.def:
συν-αυξάνω
[in LXX: 2Ma.4:4, 4Ma.13:27 * ;]
to cause to increase or grow together. Pass., to grow together: Mt 13:30 (Xen., al.).†
(AS)

G4886.def:
σύν-δεσμος, -ου, ὁ
(συνδέω), [in LXX for קֶשֶׁר, קְטַר, etc. ;]
that which binds together, a bond: of the ligaments of the body, Cl 2:19. Metaphorical, σ. ἀδικίας, At 8:23; τ. τελειότητος, Cl 3:14; τ. εἰρήνης, Ef 4:3 (see Lft., Col., ll. with).†
(AS)

G4887.def:
συν-δέω
[in LXX for שָׁבַץ, etc. ;]
__(a) to bind together;
__(b) to bind together with: pass., Hb 13:3.†
(AS)

G4888.def:
συν-δοξάζω
__1. to join in approving (Arist.).
__2. In NT only, to glorify together: pass., Rm 8:17.†
(AS)

G4889.def:
σύν-δουλος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Et 4:7, 9 4:17, 23 5:3, 6 6:6, 13 (כְּנָת) * ;]
a fellow-servant: Mt 18:28-33 24:49; of servants of the same divine Lord, Cl 1:7 4:7, Ap 6:11; so of angels, Ap 19:10 22:9.†
(AS)

G4890.def:
συνδρομή, -ῆς, ἡ
(συντρέχω), [in LXX: Jdth.10:18, 3Ma.3:8 * ;]
concourse, esp. of a riotous gathering: At 21:30 (Arist., Polyb., al.).†
(AS)

G4891.def:
συν-εγείρω
[in LXX: Êx 23:5 B2 (עָזַב), Is 14:9 (עוּר pil.), 4Ma.2:14 * ;]
to raise together: metaphorically, of the Christian's mystical resur­rection with Christ, Ef 2:6; pass., Cl 2:12 3:1.†
(AS)

G4892.def:
συνέδριον, -ου, τό
(σύν + ἕδρα, a seat) [in LXX: Pv 11:13 15:22, Jr 15:17 (סוֹד), Sl 26:4 (מַת), Pv 22:10 (דִּין) Pv 26:26 (קָהָל); Pv 24:7 27:22 31:23, 2Ma.14:5, 4Ma.17:17 * ;]
__1. a council (Plat., Xen., al.; LXX; in π., σ. τ. πρεσβυτέρων, Deiss., BS, 156): of a local Jewish tribunal, Mt 10:17, Mc 13:9.
__2. The supreme ecclesiastical court of the Jews, the Sanhedrin (i.e. Talmudic סַנְהֵדְרִין = συνέδριον): Mt 5:22 26:59, Mc 14:55 15:1, Lc 22:66, At 5:21, 27 5:34, 41 6:12, 15 22:30 23:1, 6 23:15, 20 23:28 (WH, R, mg., om.) At 24:20 of a meeting of the Sanhedrin, Jo 11:47; of the place of meeting, At 4:15.†
(AS)

G4893.def:
συν-είδησις, -εως, ἡ
(συνεῖδον), [in LXX: Ec 10:20 (מַדָּע), Wis.17:11, Sir.42:18 א * ;]
__1. consciousness: with genitive obj., Hb 10:2, 1Pe 2:19.
__2. In ethical sense, innate discernment, self-judging consciousness, conscience (Stoics and late writers): Rm 2:15 9:1, 1Co 10:29, 2Co 1:12 4:2 5:11, 1Tm 4:2, Hb 9:14; σ. ἀγαθή, At 23:1, 1Tm 1:5 1:19, 1Pe 3:16 3:21; ἀσθενής, 1Co 8:7 8:10; ἀσθενοῦσα, 1Co 8:12; ἀπρόσκοπος, At 24:16; καθαρά, 1Tm 3:9, 2Tm 1:3; καλή, Hb 13:18; πονηρά, Hb 10:22; ὁ νοῦς καὶ ἡ σ., Tt 1:15; διὰ τὴν σ., Rm 13:5, 1Co 10:25 10:27-28; κατὰ σ., Hb 9:9; ὑπὸ (τῆς) σ., Jo 8:1-59 [9] (Rec.), 1Co 10:29 (cf. Cremer, 233 ff.; ICC on Rm 2:15; DB, i, 468 ff.).†
(AS)

G4894.def:
συν-εῖδον irreg. aorist of συνοράω (see: εἶδον),
[in LXX: 1Ma.4:21 א, 2Ma.2:24 2Mac 4:4 2Mac 4:41 R 2Ma.5:17 2Mac 7:4 2Mac 7:20 2Mac 8:8, 3Ma.2:8 A * ;]
__1. to see together or at the same time (Arist., Xen.).
__2. to see in one view, hence, of mental vision, to comprehend, understand (LXX, Polyb., Plut., al.) : At 12:12 14:6 (on the related σύνοιδα, see see word).†
(AS)

G4895.def:
σύν-ειμι
(εἰμί to be), [in LXX: Jr 3:20 (רֵעַ), al. ;]
to be with: Lc 9:18 (WH, mg., συνήντησαν), At 22:11.†
(AS)

G4897.def:
συν-εισ-έρχομαι
[in LXX: Jó 22:4 (עִם בּוֹא), etc. ;]
to enter together: with dative of person(s), before εἰς, with accusative loc., Jo 6:22 18:15.†
(AS)

G4899.def:
συν-εκ-λεκτός, -ή, -όν
chosen together with, co-elect: ἡ ἐν Βαβυλῶνι συνεκλεκτή (on the meaning, see ICC, in l), 1Pe 5:13.†
(AS)
